words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.ex: He has possession of the keys.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这些钥匙。
words.en: The state of having, owning, or controlling something.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.ex: I am thankful for my friend's help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激朋友的帮助。
words.en: If you are thankful for something, you are pleased and grateful for it.

words.ex: He went outside regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾下雨就出去了。
words.en: If you say that someone does something regardless, you mean that they do it without taking account of the possible problems or difficulties.

words.ex: He hired a legal lawyer to help him.
words.ex_cn: 他请了一位法律律师来帮助他。
words.en: Relating to the law or to lawyers, or permitted or required by law.

words.tr: adj. 光荣的；可敬的；尊敬的
words.ex: He is an honorable man who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是说真话的正直的人。
words.en: Deserving respect and admiration; having high moral standards.

words.ex: He is an honourable man who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位正直可敬的人，总是说真话。
words.en: If you describe people or actions as honourable, you mean that they are good and deserve to be respected and admired.

words.ex: Goodness, I didn't expect to see you here!
words.ex_cn: 天哪，我没料到会在这里见到你！
words.en: Goodness is the quality of being kind, helpful, and honest.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.ex: He skipped the hard question and moved to the next one.
words.ex_cn: 他略过了难题，继续做下一题。
words.en: To move lightly and quickly, making a small jump after each step.

words.ex: She has an extraordinary talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 她具有非凡的音乐天赋。
words.en: Something that is extraordinary is very unusual or remarkable.

words.ex: He gave a simple explanation for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的错误给出了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An explanation is a statement or account that makes something clear or provides a reason for something.

words.ex: The palm tree grows near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 棕榈树长在海滩附近。
words.en: The inner surface of the hand that extends from the wrist to the base of the fingers; also refers to the tropical tree with large divided leaves.

words.tr: adj. 想不到的；意料之外的；
words.ex: The rain was unexpected.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨是意想不到的。
words.en: If an event or someone's behaviour is unexpected, it surprises you because you were not expecting it to happen or because you did not think that person would behave in that way.

words.tr: adj. 自鸣得意的；沾沾自喜的
words.ex: He smiled in a smug way after winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在赢得比赛后得意地笑了。
words.en: If you say that someone is smug, you are criticizing the fact they seem very pleased with how good, clever, or lucky they are.

words.ex: The pope is considered infallible in matters of faith by some Catholics.
words.ex_cn: 一些天主教徒认为教皇在信仰问题上是一贯正确的。
words.en: If a person or thing is infallible, they are never wrong or never fail.

words.ex: He envisions a world without war.
words.ex_cn: 他想象一个没有战争的世界。
words.en: To envision something is to imagine it as a future possibility; it is often used to describe the act of foreseeing or planning for the future.

words.tr:
v. 作嗡嗡声；飞驰；陡升
n. 直线上升；激增；嗡嗡声
words.ex: The bee zooms around the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在花丛中嗡嗡飞舞。
words.en: to move quickly or suddenly with a loud, low, continuous noise, or to make something do this

words.tr: phrase. 下来；吞下；弯下；写下
words.ex: He got down from the chair slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地从椅子上下来。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower position; to write something down; to cause someone to feel sad or depressed.

words.ex: She had to learn to say no to unreasonable demands.
words.ex_cn: 她不得不学会拒绝不合理的要求。
words.en: To refuse or decline something.

words.ex: He takes risks to start his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他冒险创业。
words.en: To undertake actions or decisions that involve the possibility of loss or failure.

words.tr: phrase. 努力达到，设法完成（目标）
words.ex: He works toward a better future every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在为更美好的未来而努力。
words.en: To make an effort to achieve or complete something.

words.ex: He works towards a better future every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在为更美好的未来而努力。
words.en: To make efforts to achieve or reach something.

words.ex: He is known as a great teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被称为一位优秀的老师。
words.en: If someone or something is known as a particular name, they are called by that name.

words.ex: Be careful not to step on the broken glass.
words.ex_cn: 小心不要踩到碎玻璃。
words.en: To place one's foot down on top of something.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人出人头地；让某人有所成就；造就某人
words.ex: Don't make something of someone just because they look different.
words.ex_cn: 不要因为别人看起来不一样就对他们妄下结论。
words.en: To cause someone to become a particular kind of person or to achieve a particular status.

words.tr: phrase. 充分利用某事；使某事变得重要；从某事中得出意义或结论
words.ex: He wants to make something of his life.
words.ex_cn: 他想让自己的人生有所成就。
words.en: To understand or derive benefit from something.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏；不足；达不到（目标）；不符合
words.ex: They fall short of their goal every time.
words.ex_cn: 他们每次都没能达到目标。
words.en: To fail to reach a desired standard, level, or amount.

words.ex: He went for a walk regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去散步了。
words.en: Without taking into account; without being affected by.

words.tr: phrase. 表明立场；明确立场
words.ex: He decided to take a stand on the controversial issue.
words.ex_cn: 他决定在这个有争议的问题上表明立场。
words.en: To take a stand means to adopt a firm position on a particular issue, often in a public or formal manner.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；象征；支持；容忍
words.ex: The letter A stands for apple.
words.ex_cn: 字母A代表苹果。
words.en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

words.tr: phrase. 落入（圈套）；上当；倾心
words.ex: He fell for the scam and lost his money.
words.ex_cn: 他落入了骗局，失去了钱。
words.en: To be deceived by someone or something; to develop a romantic or strong liking for someone or something.

words.ex: He arrives on time every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都准时到达。
words.en: If something happens on time, it happens at the time that was planned.

words.ex: Health is the most important thing in life.
words.ex_cn: 健康是生活中最重要的事情。
words.en: Of the greatest significance or value.

words.tr: phrase. 逐步使自己地位上升；获得晋升
words.ex: He started as a cleaner and worked his way up to manager.
words.ex_cn: 他从清洁工做起，一步步升到了经理。
words.en: To gradually progress or advance in a job, position, or status through effort and hard work.

words.tr: phrase. 选择；追求；努力争取
words.ex: I want to go for the blue shirt.
words.ex_cn: 我对那件蓝色的衬衫感兴趣。
words.en: If you go for something, you choose it or try to achieve it.

words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or to exist without needing proof or evidence.

words.ex: He helps out at the store after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在商店帮忙。
words.en: To assist someone in doing something or in a difficult situation.

words.ex: He is ahead of his classmates in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上比同学领先。
words.en: In front of or before something in time or space.
